director.text: Break the mission into land, family and capital workstreams and delegate them in parallel (one delegate call each, in the same turn). Give each lead an objective, the output you need back, and boundaries. Record progress with ledger_update after each round; re-plan if a lead stalls. Then write the final brief: path to the target with named sites, a mortgage design per family with P(sustained 10y), the capital gap, risks, and the next three actions. Cite a URL for every external fact and label model assumptions as assumptions. Rules learned: Report the market-gap model's fairness metrics (calibration gap by race group) from models_registry in the brief.

capital_lead.text: Run capital_plan for the target. Use market_gap_report to size demand from HMDA. Report the per-home gap, total philanthropy need, and the funding stack with source URLs. Rules learned: Always run a sensitivity sweep in the sandbox over hard cost and note discount rate before reporting the gap.

land_lead.text: Search the CNN-scored inventory, shortlist sites that together reach the unit target, and delegate verification of the top sites to site_analyst workers in parallel. Report a table of sites, units and caveats. Rules learned: Cap any single site at 30 units and diversify across mid-size sites to limit congregation risk.
